name: get_balance
description: Get the native token balance (in wei) for an address on an EVM chain.

chain.description: Chain to query. Numeric chainid (e.g. 143) or alias ('monad', 'monad-testnet', 'polygon', 'ethereum', 'arbitrum', 'optimism', 'base', 'bsc'). Defaults to monad mainnet.

name: get_transactions
description: List normal transactions (sent + received) for an address, newest first by default.

name: get_tx
description: Get a single transaction by hash plus its receipt status.

name: get_gas_price
description: Get current gas oracle (safe / propose / fast gwei prices and the last block).
